objective: Final unseen paired evaluation of frozen Model A and frozen primary Model B on the same newly acquired, previously unseen laboratory flows. This is the final major ML/generalization experiment; no Phase 17E, no new attack families, no additional models.

authorized_lab.no_other_target: Do not target any other host, address, subnet or external system.

pcap_policy: PCAPs may remain gitignored; hashes and provenance are tracked.

must_not_depend_on: whether detection looks good or bad
acceptance.rerun_rule: If a run fails a support or capture-quality requirement, record the failure and rerun using the SAME predefined traffic procedure. The procedure is never changed based on model performance.

ground_truth.source: pre-declared scenario manifests (training/configs/live/*.yaml) via app/live/manifest.py: expected_for_flow; identical rule to the adaptation protocol
ground_truth.benign: run_level_uniform BENIGN from a clean benign window with no attack procedure running

portscan.note: frozen directional rule 192.168.50.10 -> 192.168.50.20; reverse/unrelated flows remain UNLABELLED

ssh.note: same frozen controlled SSH authentication-attempt scenario and ground-truth rule as the adaptation protocol

ground_truth.independence: Ground truth is constructed only from the manifest selectors and never from model predictions or mere temporal proximity. Prediction fields are not exposed to the ground-truth construction code.

blinding.rule: Acquire, validate, hash and seal ALL 9 runs BEFORE examining any Model A or Model B prediction.
blinding.during_acquisition: Do NOT inspect prediction outputs to decide whether another run is needed.
order: only then begin prediction and comparison

model_a.role: frozen multiclass detector (existing deployment inference path)
model_a.name: xgb-baseline-cicids2017-v2
model_a.binary_operational_rule: Model A predicts ATTACK when its frozen multiclass prediction is any non-BENIGN class; BENIGN when its frozen prediction is BENIGN. Multiclass attribution is kept separately.
model_a.policy: not retrained, not modified, feature contract unchanged, decision rule unchanged

model_b.policy: not retrained, not tuned, not calibrated, threshold not modified

models.secondary_note: RF and unweighted XGB remain Phase 17C secondary evidence and are NOT used as alternate final models even if they may perform better.
models.final_comparison: FROZEN MODEL A vs FROZEN PRIMARY MODEL B

paired_evaluation.rule: Model A and Model B score the exact same evaluable flows.
paired_evaluation.ground_truth_isolation: prediction fields are not exposed to the ground-truth construction code

metrics.primary_rationale: PortScan has far more flows than SSH, so no single pooled attack metric is primary.
metrics.ssh_support_disclosure: The SSH sample size is always reported; an observed zero is never a true population zero (Wilson upper bound reported).
metrics.secondary_label: Pooled metrics are labelled SECONDARY because PortScan dominates flow count.
metrics.forbidden_comparison: Model A multiclass Macro F1 must NOT be compared against Model B binary Macro F1 as though they represent the same task.

paired_analysis.mcnemar: McNemar's exact test may be reported as a SECONDARY paired diagnostic where statistically appropriate and correctly implemented; it never overrides the descriptive results, and no fishing across many tests.

comparison_with_validation.rule: Compare final unseen results descriptively with Phase 17C validation; do NOT merge final-test and validation samples.
comparison_with_validation.honesty: Do not rewrite the interpretation to force support for H2.

trade_off.rule: Explicitly assess whether Model B substantially improves PortScan/SSH detection relative to Model A and at what cost in BENIGN false positives; report both sides together.
trade_off.caveat: Increased detection alone is not described as an unconditional improvement.

no_post_hoc_tuning.bug_rule: If a genuine software bug is discovered, STOP, document it before changing anything, and determine whether the entire affected evaluation must be rerun. Never silently patch after seeing results.

freeze.verify_no_overlap: no adaptation or validation run appears in final test

stop_after: paired comparison, intervals, secondary paired test if justified, integrity tests, results committed and pushed. Do NOT proceed to new ML experiments, new families, another model, threshold optimization, SHAP/LLM human evaluation, thesis or slide rewriting.
